headline: OKC Climbs, San Antonio Slips
caption:
One week, and the NBA title race already moved.

OKC is the biggest riser, going from 25% to 27% between Oct 13 and Oct 20, and they're sitting at their peak. Houston also ticked up, 8% to 9%.

San Antonio is the story going the other way. The Spurs climbed as high as 22% before sliding to 17%, down from 19% at the start. New York dipped from 14% to 12%. Detroit held steady at 6%.

Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day. Who climbs the chart next week?
